summary: Your eighth Sunday review. You answer 8 questions on timeouts, retries, prompt rules, ablation and context in your own words, extend your glossary, check your before and after note from memory, tag week 8 and plan week 9 (including checking that Docker works).
goal: Explain timeouts, retries, prompt rules, ablation and context in your own words, and plan week 9.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 8 questions in your own words with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Glossary: add 7 new words with a one-line definition and an example from your assistant
Say your before and after result from memory, then check it against your note
Error log: group these two weeks' confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Run git tag week-8 and see tag: week-8 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 9: one outcome sentence, 7 sessions in your calendar, a drop list, and check that Docker starts
Play the Week 8 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
